   MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING
  NORWALK COMMUNITY PROMOTION COMMISSION
  July 13, 2026

Vice Chair Lopez called the meeting to order at 6:08 p.m. and Commissioner Sanchez led the Flag
Salute. Responding to roll call were Vice Chair Lopez, Commissioner Garcia, and Commissioner
Sanchez. Chair Ang was absent. Also present was Levy Sun, Director of Communications, Alex
Ocegueda, Office Assistant III, and Marcus Dawal, Communications Specialist.

APPROVAL OF MINUTES

Commissioner Sanchez made the motion and Commissioner Garcia seconded to approve the minutes
for June 8, 2026. There being no objection, the motion carried.

REPORTS

First Responders Luncheon

Mrs. Ocegueda asked Commissioners which restaurants they would like to get a food quote from.
Commissioners discussed and asked that staff get quotes from the following: Norwalk High School
Catering, Mr. Rosewood, Angie’s, Lupita’s, and Los Compadres. Mrs. Ocegueda will have the flyer
invitation at the next meeting. Mrs. Ocegueda also confirmed that paper placemats will be ordered for
Commissioners to distribute to local middle schools for students to create artwork for the event.
Commissioner Sanchez requested that staff research the possibility of presenting recognition
certificates during the event.

Commissioners Appreciation Dinner

Mrs. Ocegueda invited Commissioners to provide feedback on this year's event to assist with planning
for next year. Commissioner Sanchez suggested that staff explore entertainment options, such as a
comedian or magician, for future events. Mrs. Ocegueda also proposed establishing criteria for
selecting recipients of recognition certificates presented during the event. Commissioners agreed that
developing formal criteria would be beneficial and requested that the topic be brought back for further
discussion at a future meeting. Mrs. Ocegueda also confirmed that next year's event is scheduled for
Friday, June 11, 2027, and stated that she will submit the necessary paperwork to reserve the venue.

Merchandise

Mrs. Ocegueda stated she unfortunately did not have an update on the merchandise as staff is still
waiting on a response from the Finance Department. Mrs. Ocegueda will continue to reach out to
provide an update at the next meeting.

Keepin’ It Norwalk

Mr. Sun presented the “Keepin’ It Norwalk” campaign video, June Sit-Down Restaurant edition, to the
Commissioners.
 Minutes of the Regular Meeting
Community Promotion Commission
July 13, 2026

Communications Analytics

Mr. Sun presented monthly performance metrics across digital platforms. The Commission received
and filed the report.

STAFF COMMENTS:

Mrs. Ocegueda informed the Commission that the second video in the PastForward Series has been
posted and presented the video. Mr. Sun reported the current number of 270 responses received for
the Community Band survey being conducted at city events. Mr. Sun also introduced Communication
Specialist, Marcus Dawal, to the Commission.

COMMISSIONERS COMMENTS:

Vice Chair Lopez detailed her experiences at the Independence Day Festival and the first Summer
concert working the Commissions booth. Commissioner Sanchez detailed his experiences at the
Independence Day Festival working with the Halloween Parade Foundation.

ADJOURNMENT

There being no further business, the meeting was adjourned at 7:08 p.m.

_____________________________

Natalie Montiel Lopez, Vice Chair
Community Promotion Commission
